story.fullStory:
Alabama's "Dixieland Delight" — original release 1983. "Dixieland Delight" is a song by American country music band Alabama.

Written by Ronnie Rogers, from Tennessee, it was released on January 28, 1983, by RCA Nashville Records as the lead single for Alabama's seventh studio album, The Closer You Get....

"Dixieland Delight" drew commercial success, peaking at number one on the Billboard Hot Country Songs list amongst the release of the album in April 1983.

Dixieland Delight was released in 1983.
